name: Dashboard
purpose: Central hub showing unified view of all modules, quick stats, correlations, and AI insights

key_features.name: Hero Section
key_features.description: Shows user avatar, current level, XP progress, and daily greeting

key_features.name: Today's Plan Widget
key_features.description: Shows scheduled time blocks and tasks for today from Calendar module

key_features.name: Streak Stats Widget
key_features.description: Displays active streaks across all modules with flame indicators

key_features.name: Module Health Widget
key_features.description: Shows health/activity status of each module as percentage

key_features.name: Quick Actions Widget
key_features.description: Buttons for common actions: Log Workout, Add Task, Write Journal, etc.

key_features.name: Weekly Insights Widget
key_features.description: AI-generated insights about user patterns and suggestions

key_features.name: Financial Snapshot Widget
key_features.description: Quick view of budget status, spending, and savings goals

key_features.name: Goals Progress Widget
key_features.description: Progress bars for active goals across modules

key_features.name: Recent Activity Widget
key_features.description: Timeline of recent actions across all modules

related_modules: All modules feed data to Dashboard
tips: The dashboard is the default landing page
Widgets can be customized in Settings
Click any widget to go to its source module
